i.norm: Verifies that isSet(String) returns false when the record has no header mapping (parser is null), and that the record's positional metadata (record number, byte/character position) and size are correct.
Create a 2-element record with no parser (null), an empty comment, record number 1105, character position 0, and byte position 0.
isSet(String) requires a header mapping from the parser; with a null parser it always returns false.
